description:
Three review findings on the Producer converge into one refactor:

1. Stop using Process.put/get to share state with Req's \`into:\` callback. Use Req's \`private:\` option — pass \`private: %{producer: state}\` to Req.post!, read/write via Req.Request.get_private/put_private inside the callback.

2. Replace \`GenServer.start\` (unlinked) + mutual monitor with a supervised Task under a Task.Supervisor owned by OctoPi.AI.Providers.Anthropic.Application. Task is the idiomatic shape: caller wants a linked process that emits messages and ends.

3. Narrow the rescue: replace \`rescue e\` catch-all with \`rescue e in [Req.TransportError, Req.HTTPError, Jason.DecodeError, RuntimeError]\`. Let unknown crashes propagate to the supervisor. Log stacktrace via Logger.error(Exception.format(:error, e, __STACKTRACE__)) before converting to Event.Error.

TDD:
- Existing producer tests stay green (106 currently).
- Add a regression test: spawn 2 concurrent producers against different fake plugs, assert no state cross-contamination.
- Add a test: raising a random RuntimeError mid-stream emits Event.Error with the message and the stream terminates.

Files: apps/octo_pi_ai_anthropic/lib/octo_pi/ai/providers/anthropic/{producer.ex, application.ex, anthropic.ex}; producer_test.exs.
title: Producer refactor: Req :private state, supervised Task, narrow rescue
